note: The lab host the launchd landing controller runs on: the host of the controller's files. Its ticks.jsonl, decisions.jsonl, state.json and workers/<lease>/result.json exist on that host only, so the merge sweep pins a diagnose lane there only when the lane has a controller reason (sweep_rules.plan gives it host and host_why; merge_sweep.js writes the brief's Required host: line). A floor-only diagnose lane reads no controller file and is placed by the pool (OMN-17427). Five diagnose lanes placed by load on 2026-10-13 ended 'unreadable from this host'. sweep_rules.load_controller_host reads this file; moving the controller is an edit here. diagnose_repo is the repository every diagnose lane is started in (the runner refuses a start with no --repo, REMOTE-LANE-JOB-SPEC-REFUSED, 2026-11-05: a diagnose plan recorded repo null and the frozen dispatcher omitted --repo, about 170k tokens per refused try). It names the registry repository of the sweep workflow, as omnimarket#5054 does; it is never picked from an under-floor string, which can be unread or name several repositories. sweep_rules.load_diagnose_repo reads it and the plan refuses to name a diagnose lane without it.
